name: Monotone Mesh Generation
definition: Monotone decomposition generates mesh by sweeping planes along each axis and extracting polygons where voxels exist, ensuring manifold geometry without per-voxel duplication.
summary: Monotone Mesh Generation converts voxel data into manifold triangle meshes using a sweep-line approach that merges adjacent faces into larger polygons, producing cleaner, lower-poly geometry than basic greedy methods.
